title: Firework Explosion
description: Turns TNT and other explosive blocks into beautiful fireworks!
body:
## 🎆 FireworkExplosion —
**Say goodbye to boring explosions every blast on your server is now a stunning fireworks show! Protect your buildings by forbidding blowing up anything on your territory.**
 
**✨ Features:**
 
TNT — red firework [🔴]

End Crystal — purple firework [🟣]

TNT Minecart — light gray firework [⚪]

Respawn Anchor — yellow firework [🟡]
 

Zone System — fireworks only inside defined areas, outside zones explosions behave normally

Action Bar Message — beautiful notification on every explosion

Full config.yml customization — colors, firework shape, message text

Persistent Zones — zones are saved and restored after server restart
 
 
**📋 Commands:**
 
/fwset <zone> 1 → Set the first corner of a zone

/fwset <zone> 2 → Set the second corner of a zone

/fwzone on → Enable zone mode

/fwzone off → Disable zone mode

/fwzone list → List all zones

/fwzone delete <zone> → Delete a zone

/fwreload → Reload config without restarting
 
_All commands require operator permissions._
 
 
**🔧 Installation:**
 
1. Download FireworkExplosion.jar
2. Place it in your server's plugins/ folder
3. Restart the server
4. Configure config.yml to your liking
 
 
_**Made by Likon**_
